morgan: quick heads up — release blocked: CI job 98765 artifact upload stuck, deploy-scheduler paused promotion.

deploy-bot: promotion_hold: pipeline 98765 paused due to artifact-staging-timeout. See /ops/releases. :warning:

toni: infra check -> eu-west-1 S3 edge returning 503 on multipart parts. uploader stuck at part 1/4. logs show repeated 503 and client retries.

sam: change window at 23:00 UTC. if QA hasn't greened, we should manual-pin last known good to avoid rolling a flaky image.

maya: QA: latest image fails analytics e2e 5/5. last-good tag `release-20260208-123` is clean.

morgan: proposal: manual pin to release-20260208-123, open rollback PR for current commit, ops to notify customers. we'll retry the failing pipeline async after infra stabilization.

deploy-bot: promotion_attempt blocked: artifact metadata mismatch between registry and index; auto-promo disabled.

toni: mitigation executed: aborted stuck multipart upload and reuploaded artifact to eu-central-1 single-part. reupload complete, checksum sha256:9f3a... matches.

maya: QA ran focused smoke + analytics-worker e2e against reuploaded artifact — all green.

morgan: action: pin/promote `release-20260208-123` to prod now with note "manual pin due to artifact staging stall + flaky e2e". retry original pipeline in 2 hours. ops: @support @sales notified. :thumbsup:
